title: Travel Credit Terms of the Air Ticket Fare Brands
content:
A travel credit produced by a booking held in one of the Air Ticket Fare Brands takes its terms from the brand that produced it. Three quantities are scheduled.

**Credit validity term.** The calendar months a travel credit stays redeemable from its issue date.

**Reissue fee.** The fee to reissue a lapsed travel credit onto a new voucher.

**Transferability.** Whether a travel credit may be redeemed by someone other than the named traveller.

| Fare brand | Credit validity (months) | Reissue fee (USD) | Transferable |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Basic Economy Lite | 0 | 0.00 | no |
| Economy Saver | 12 | 75.00 | no |
| Economy Classic | 12 | 75.00 | no |
| Economy Flex | 18 | 50.00 | no |
| Premium Economy Select | 18 | 50.00 | yes |
| Business Saver | 24 | 25.00 | yes |
| Business Flex | 24 | 0.00 | yes |

## Distinctions the schedule draws

The validity term takes four values only: 0 months on Basic Economy Lite, 12 months on Economy Saver and Economy Classic, 18 months on Economy Flex and Premium Economy Select, and 24 months on the two Business brands.

Transferability turns at Premium Economy Select: the four brands below it are scheduled as not transferable, the three from Premium Economy Select upwards as transferable. Note that Economy Flex and Premium Economy Select share a validity term of 18 months and a reissue fee of 50.00 USD yet differ on transferability, so the validity term never settles the transferability question on its own.

The reissue fee falls as the brand rises and reaches 0.00 USD only on Business Flex.

## A hypothetical reading of the table

A voucher produced by a Business Saver booking is scheduled to run 24 months from its issue date, may be redeemed by someone other than the named traveller, and carries a reissue fee of 25.00 USD. A voucher produced by an Economy Saver booking is scheduled to run 12 months, may not be so redeemed, and carries a reissue fee of 75.00 USD.
